task.prompt: Support reports a checkout bug. A single quote service first receives `{ customerId: 'VIP-001', subtotalCents: 10000 }` and correctly returns `totalCents: 9000`. When that same service later receives `{ customerId: 'VIP-001', subtotalCents: 20000 }`, the checkout still shows 9000 instead of 18000. Reproduce the report, add a meaningful regression test using the exact customer ID and both reported subtotals, find and fix the root cause, and run `npm test` successfully. Keep the public exports and unrelated tests unchanged.

checks.command: node --input-type=module -e "import {createQuoteService} from './src/index.js'; const scenarios = [['VIP-001', 10000, 20000, 9000, 18000], ['VIP-002', 7500, 12500, 6750, 11250], ['REGULAR-7', 999, 2499, 999, 2499]]; for (const [customerId, firstSubtotal, secondSubtotal, firstTotal, secondTotal] of scenarios) { const service = createQuoteService(); const first = service.quote({customerId, subtotalCents: firstSubtotal}); const second = service.quote({customerId, subtotalCents: secondSubtotal}); const repeated = service.quote({customerId, subtotalCents: secondSubtotal}); if (first.totalCents !== firstTotal || second.totalCents !== secondTotal || repeated !== second) { console.error({customerId, first, second, firstTotal, secondTotal, reused: repeated === second}); process.exit(1); } }"
